thread:
emily_ml: kicking off onboarding for the new Axiom-7B-MQA weights. quick checklist: weights s3 path, tokenizer, config validation, and runtime compatibility (RoPE/GQA/MQA).
frank_runtime: thanks — can you drop the exact s3 path and config you want us to validate?
emily_ml: s3://redwood-models/axiom/7b/mqa/v1/weights.tar.gz and tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/axiom/7b/tokenizer.json. config snippet below:
```yaml
model: axiom-7b-mqa
roper_scaling: true
quantization: mqa
kv_cache: enabled
attention: flash_fallback: true
sliding_window: {chunk_size: 1024, overlap: 128}
```
chloe: tiny nit: key in config is ropE_scaling in some old onboarding docs, watch casing. also we should pin ropE_scale_factor for Axiom tests.
benji: re: tokenizer — I ran a quick tokenization pass on sample prompts and hit an out-of-range id: IndexError: token id 50257 out of range (vocab size 50257). looks like tokenizer.json expects eos id 50256 but some generation path producing 50257.
emily_ml: hmm — Axiom's tokenizer was exported from a slightly different BPE tooling. when converting we dropped a sentinel token. frank, can runtime handle off-by-one vocab id, or do we reject?
frank_runtime: runtime can't silently remap ids. we should either fix tokenizer on upload or add a mapping layer in the model config: token_id_offset: -1 (temporary). but prefer re-export.
dave_infra: re-export would be cleanest. if you can't, we can add a preloading hook to remap ids at load time (low risk). which do you prefer?
emily_ml: I'll try re-export first. if blocked, we'll use the hook. also note: MQA packing layout differs from GQA tests — storage layout affects memcpy stride in the attention kernel.
frank_runtime: yes. GQA vs MQA affects per-head packing. we need tests for both: run kernel-check with these flags: --quant=mqa --gqa=false and --quant=gqa --gqa=true. CI job name: runtime/quant-compat/axiom-7b.
ci-bot: queued job runtime/quant-compat/axiom-7b #4321 (linux-x86, cuda-12)
benji: CI failed on first run: segfault in attention_cuda.cu at forward_kernel +0x2a3. minimal repro attached: short prompt 2 tokens triggers crash after 512 tokens generated.
chloe: that smells like KV cache wrap/offset bug. MQA shifted byte alignment and our kv pointer arithmetic didn't account for pack size.
emily_ml: attaching weights manifest and model card. also noted that Axiom uses rotary_scaling with base 10000 and a custom scale schedule. frank, does runtime autodetect RoPE base?
frank_runtime: we detect RoPE frequency based on config.name, but custom base must be explicit: rotary_base: 10000. If unspecified, default 10000 is used but scaling schedule needs rotary_scale_type: linear|log. set rotary_scale_type: linear and rotary_scale_alpha: 0.5 for Axiom.
benji: quick patch: in runtime PR #814 we added a fallback that switches attention impl when seq_len > 2048. but Axiom has sliding_window config chunk_size 1024 overlap 128 so we rarely hit >2048, but generation can. recommend enabling flash_fallback: true (already in emily's config).
dave_infra: note for Dedicated: storage path must be in the model store manifest. I'll add the S3 path to manifests service so deployment job can pull weights to /mnt/models/axiom/7b.
emily_ml: update — re-exported tokenizer with sentinel token restored. new tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/axiom/7b/tokenizer_v2.json. re-uploaded weights with same sha. please re-run CI.
ci-bot: queued job runtime/quant-compat/axiom-7b #4322
frank_runtime: ran locally, the segfault is replaced by a mismatch failure: "attn_out norm diff > 1e-3" between flash and legacy. looks like rotary scaling mismatch.
chloe: try toggling rotary_scale_alpha to 1.0 in config for test harness — if that reduces diff we can narrow down numeric vs packing difference.
frank_runtime: did that, diff dropped to 2e-4 but still failing our threshold. suspect order-of-ops in quant dequant path for MQA.
benji: I pushed a small change to quant.unpack to align strides (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/819). can someone review? frank, chloe?
frank_runtime: will review today. if green, we can merge and re-run CI. also add a unit test that loads weights with odd-head-count (e.g., 47 heads) to exercise packing alignment.
emily_ml: timeline: re-export done; token fix done; frank + benji to iterate on PRs; chloe to add unit test; dave to confirm manifest and deploy staging model. target: have staging endpoint with Axiom-7B-MQA in dedicated pool by EOD Fri. :calendar: :rocket:
chloe: I'll add test under tests/quant/odd_head_pack.test.py and link to PR.
dave_infra: manifest updated, staging deploy job will kick once CI passes.
benji: re: code review — left small comments, main change looks good. adding a small debug log for unpack stride.
frank_runtime: merged PR #819 (after fixes), kicked CI: runtime/quant-compat/axiom-7b #4323
ci-bot: job runtime/quant-compat/axiom-7b #4323 passed (all checks green) :tada:
emily_ml: awesome. next steps: can infra stage the image with packed weights and we'll smoke test generation for quality regressions. anyone available for a quick pairing session on Friday?
frank_runtime: available 10-11am PT.
chloe: can do 10:30.
dave_infra: will monitor deploy at 9:45 and ping when ready.
emily_ml: thanks all — leaving the thread open for any follow-ups. if anything blocks, ping @frank_runtime or @dave_infra. :eyes:
